casts.text:
x402 (HTTP 402 Payment Required) finally has a real implementation.

The flow:
1. Agent calls API → gets 402 + wallet address
2. Agent sends $0.01 USDC on-chain
3. Agent retries with X-Payment: <tx_hash>
4. API verifies on-chain, serves request

No OAuth. No API keys. No accounts. The payment IS the credential.
